description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Holy)], [Elemental Command Mode] and [Gulp] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Holy 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Elemental Command Mode
description.text: Grants [Conditional Attach Element with Stacking] after using four Samurai or Knight abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Gulp
description.text: Grants [100% Critical 1], [Damage Cap +10000 1] and Proficiency +1 after using two Samurai or Knight abilities, grants [Critical Damage +50% 1] if Hilda is alive after using two Samurai or Knight abilities
